description_expanded:
WaterColor, across from Dragonfly Pool!

4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths

Access to Camp Watercolor and Watercolor Beach Club

Community pools, seasonally heated

4 bikes!

Open-air balcony off the primary suite

Multiple living spaces with TVs

Quaint outdoor areas, a screened porch

Close to boutiques and 5-star restaurants

Here Comes the Sun by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Right across from Dragonfly Pool (in WaterColor!), this designer home is equal parts polished and playful. With 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, and plenty of space to relax, it's a fresh, stylish spot for your next 30A getaway. This chic 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath beach retreat comfortably sleeps 8. The stylish interiors, in crisp white and blue, are gorgeous. The heart of the home? A fully equipped galley kitchen is sleek and well-stocked, with stainless steel appliances and a dining area that feels just a little fancy, thanks to soft lighting and thoughtful details. Multiple living spaces enhance the ‘chill’.

The main living room is wide open and comfy, while the upstairs TV room is great for movie nights or quiet time. Outside, take your pick: a screened-in front porch with cushioned seating or a private balcony off the primary suite, both perfect for lazy mornings or low-key evenings. Set in WaterColor and close to parks, trails, shops, and beaches, take one of the 4 bikes and explore 30A like never before! Get ready for a memorable stay at Here Comes the Sun, where comfort meets style in a beautiful beach setting. And with Oversee 30A as your local host, help is always nearby. We’re here every day, with a 24/7 line just in case. Overview: - Designer home across from Dragonfly Pool - Access to Camp Watercolor and Watercolor Beach Club - 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths - Parking for 2 cars plus neighborhood parking - 4 bikes - Wi-Fi - Absolutely no pets, due to allergies. - Community pools heated during cooler months (subject to change) Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Guest Bedroom: Queen bed, ensuite bath, walk-in shower, double vanity, TV SECOND FLOOR - Primary Suite: King bed, ensuite bath, walk-in shower, double vanity, TV, private open balcony - Primary Bedroom: King bed, shared bath, double vanity, shower/tub combo, TV - Bunkroom: Twin bunks, shared hall bath, double vanity, shower/tub combo Check-in is at 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is at 10:00 AM CST
